rule: identical prompts (also against the hindsight prompt), and near-duplicates at word 8-gram Jaccard >= 0.5 against one training text after removing each set's own layout (Ekbasis-27B's audit rule, exact best match)

rules.identical: normalized floor == a training floor or ceiling
rules.near: |s|>=10 and exact best Jaccard >= 0.5 vs one training floor or ceiling (s = floor 8-grams minus the set's layout; t = all the training text's 8-grams)
rules.near_ekbasis: same, floors only (pi_overlap.py's rule, exact best row)
rules.near_ekbasis_top20: same, floors only, best of the 20 floors sharing the most 8-grams (pi_overlap.py as run)
rules.near_symmetric: sensitivity: the set's layout also removed from the training text
rules.flagged: identical OR near (the exclusion used for the clean numbers)
